summary: Iteration 58 — Full backend + frontend validation of MamanDouce v10.5 NeriaCorp Intelligence (Admin-Only Scanner IA) + Birth List PDF + 401 layout fix. Backend: 8/8 pytest PASS on preview URL — POST /api/scanner/analyze with admin + image returns full {metadata.source_app, confidence_score, operation_mode:'Admin_Only', business, display_card.title/summary/main_action/theme_color/visual_type LIST|GRID|REPORT, financial.estimated_revenue/currency:'EUR'}; admin + text_input only also 200; no input → 400; non-admin → 403. GET /api/scanner/apps admin returns 5 apps (VisaTrace #1A5CAD/29.99, Heritia #8B4513/60, VeoVision #000000/40, Vellumia #D4AF37/60, Aevis #2E8B57/40) + operation_mode 'Admin_Only'; non-admin → 403. GET /api/scanner/audit admin returns {scans, total_count, total_revenue, currency:'EUR', by_app}; non-admin → 403. Frontend: /admin (admin@mamandouce.com) shows the golden NeriaCorp Intelligence drawer with data-testid='drawer-neriacorp'; clicking it opens SubDrawer 'Scanner IA Admin-Only' with No-Log banner, Photo+Importer buttons, Texte textarea, Métadonnées JSON input, 'Analyser via NeriaCorp Intelligence' CTA. /birth-list 'Ma Liste' tab with seeded favorites shows data-testid='export-pdf-birthlist-btn' with classes 'btn-rose-bonbon' and label 'Télécharger en PDF (catalogue)'; clicking it triggers a download of 'mamandouce-liste-naissance-2026-05-11.pdf' (13.6 KB). /scanner-ai is no longer accessible (body content empty/minimal — route removed). NO 'Erreur chargement layout' console log on /auth before login (verified — 0 matches in console).
critical_code_review_comments: scanner_ai.py (NeriaCorp) uses Depends(get_admin_user) on all 3 endpoints — admin gate is enforced uniformly.

Backfill logic (theme_color + estimated_revenue from APP_DEFAULTS, currency default 'EUR', operation_mode='Admin_Only') guarantees a stable response shape even if GPT-4o omits fields — defensive and correct.
No-Log policy correctly persists only admin_id/email, source_app, confidence_score, estimated_revenue, currency, created_at to scanner_audit (no image_base64, no business JSON) — privacy honored.
Audit endpoint excludes _id via projection {_id:0} — safe for JSON serialization.
JSON fence stripping (```json ... ```) before json.loads is robust; falls back to 502 with the first 200 chars of raw IA output — good error visibility.
BirthListPage favorites are stored as an array of item IDs (strings) in 'mamandouce_birthlist_favorites' — confirmed and works with PDF export.
